item.title: Applications sought for 1st District judicial vacancy
item.description: The application process is now open for a vacancy in the 1st Judicial District. This seat will be chambered in Shakopee in Scott County.

item.title: State adopts rapid injunction law to stop elder scams
item.description: Minnesota’s new financial exploitation injunction law allows courts to freeze assets fast to protect vulnerable adults from scams and abuse.

item.title: Perspectives: ICE surveillance here recalls high court cases
item.description: ICE’s high-tech surveillance of Minnesota protesters draws on decades-old Supreme Court rulings that limit legal challenges to government monitoring.

item.title: Milwaukee man who framed immigrant for Trump threats gets 16 years
item.description: Demetric Scott was sentenced to 16½ years after framing immigrant Ramón Morales Reyes with fake death threats against Trump to get him deported.

item.title: Judge blocks Virginia law limiting kids’ social media time
item.description: A federal judge in Virginia issued a preliminary injunction against a law limiting minors' social media time to one hour daily per platform, citing First Amendment concerns.

item.title: U.S. Supreme Court declines to review AI-generated art copyright case
item.description: The U.S. Supreme Court declined to hear a case on whether AI-generated art can be copyrighted, upholding the requirement for human authorship under U.S. law.

item.title: U.S. Supreme Court wrestles with gun ownership ban for illegal drug users
item.description: The U.S. Supreme Court heard arguments on the constitutionality of a federal law barring illegal drug users from owning guns under the Second Amendment.

item.title: U.S. Supreme Court rebuffs challenge to ban on gun ownership by nonviolent felons
item.description: The U.S. Supreme Court refused to hear a case challenging the federal ban on gun ownership by nonviolent felons, upholding the Gun Control Act of 1968.

item.title: Applications sought for 10th District judgeships
item.description: Commission is accepting applications for three judge vacancies in the 10th District due to retirements. Deadline is March 23, with interviews in April.
